// CASE a_fn_destructured_param expect=pass
const width = 1;
export async function runA({ items, width }) {
  await mapLimit(items, width, save);
}
// CASE b_body_object_destructure expect=pass
const width2 = 1;
export async function runB(items, config) {
  const { width2 } = config;
  await mapLimit(items, width2, save);
}
// CASE c_body_array_destructure expect=pass
const width3 = 1;
export async function runC(load) {
  const [items, width3] = await load();
  await mapLimit(items, width3, save);
}
// CASE d_arrow_destructured_param expect=pass
export async function runD(groups) {
  const limit = 1;
  const first = await db.find({ limit });
  await Promise.all(groups.map(({ items, limit }) => mapLimit(items, limit, save)));
  return first;
}
// CASE e_default_destructured_param expect=pass
const width5 = 1;
export async function runE(items, { width5 = 4 } = {}) {
  await mapLimit(items, width5, save);
}
// CASE f_options_fn_destructured_param expect=pass
const concurrency = 1;
export async function runF({ items, concurrency }) {
  await mapLimit(items, save, { concurrency });
}
// CASE g_renamed_destructure expect=pass
const width7 = 1;
export async function runG(items, config) {
  const { parallel: width7 } = config;
  await mapLimit(items, width7, save);
}
// CASE h_local_then_inner_fn_destructure expect=pass
export async function runH(items, configs) {
  const width = 1;
  await warmup(items, width);
  for (const config of configs) {
    void config;
  }
  const process = async ({ width }) => mapLimit(items, width, save);
  await process({ width: 4 });
}
// CASE control_fire expect=fire
export async function control(items) {
  const width = 1;
  await mapLimit(items, width, save);
}
// CASE end expect=pass
